2608.19759.title: GOAG: Generative and Object-Agnostic Grasp Planner for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
2608.19759.paper_summary: Multifingered grasping is a crucial robotic skill, but current deep-learning grasp planners often struggle to generalize to new objects because they are trained on limited, object-specific datasets. We introduce a fundamentally different approach, grounded in the observation that the gripper and the object share identical surface geometry at their mutual contact points. We propose GOAG: Generative and Object-Agnostic Grasp Planner for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation, a novel deep generative model that learns a compact latent representation of a specific gripper's contact surface distribution, enabling the efficient sampling of valid grasp configurations without relying on object-specific training data. We show that by introducing object features only at inference time, our model can effectively retrieve admissible contact areas that are compatible with the gripper's capabilities. We validate our approach through extensive experiments on established grasp protocols in both simulated and real-world scenarios, demonstrating its effectiveness with different grippers from the literature. Our method delivers state-of-the-art results on the objects from the MultiDex dataset, achieving an average success rate of 86.93%. It offers significantly faster processing when generating numerous grasps, while matching the performance of leading approaches specifically trained on this dataset. Unlike these methods, our approach does not rely on object-specific training data, highlighting the advantages of object-agnostic learning. It effectively addresses the generalization challenges faced by traditional data-driven grasp planners. Code and videos are available on our project website https://cea-list.github.io/goagweb/ .
2608.19759.paper_summary_zh: 多指抓取是一項關鍵的機器人技能，但目前的深度學習抓取規劃器往往難以對新物體進行泛化，因為它們是在有限的、特定物體的數據集上訓練的。我們提出了一種根本不同的方法，這基於一個觀察，即夾具和物體在它們的接觸點上共享相同的表面幾何形狀。我們提出了GOAG：生成性和物體無關的靈巧機器人操作抓取規劃器，一種新穎的深度生成模型，學習特定夾具的接觸表面分佈的緊湊潛在表示，從而能夠高效地採樣有效的抓取配置，而無需依賴於特定物體的訓練數據。我們展示了通過在推理時僅引入物體特徵，我們的模型可以有效地檢索與夾具能力相容的可接受接觸區域。我們通過在模擬和現實世界場景中對既定抓取協議進行廣泛實驗來驗證我們的方法，展示了其在文獻中不同夾具上的有效性。我們的方法在MultiDex數據集中的物體上提供了最先進的結果，達到了86.93%的平均成功率。在生成大量抓取時，它提供了顯著更快的處理速度，同時匹配了專門在該數據集上訓練的領先方法的性能。與這些方法不同，我們的方法不依賴於特定物體的訓練數據，突顯了物體無關學習的優勢。它有效地解決了傳統數據驅動抓取規劃器面臨的泛化挑戰。代碼和視頻可在我們的項目網站 https://cea-list.github.io/goagweb/ 獲得。
